text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Banco de Comercio e Industria expanded its activities in the country by opening brances in the cities of Lobito and Benguela on Saturday.
- Cabinda Governor Jose Amaro Taty finished a 15-day visit of the United States where he met officials from Chevron oil company and some aid organisations.
_ The International Committee of the Red Cross is to start a $70,000 mine awareness programme in the diamond-rich Lunda Norte province.
